headline: Automated reference curation and search parameter selection for microbial data pipelines
label: Standardized Microbial Data Pipelines
summary: Three recent tools automate reference retrieval, search parameter selection and genome data management for microbial and proteomic datasets.
synthesis: The common thread is automation of data-preparation steps that sit upstream of microbial and proteomic analysis. Ratatoskr is a Python tool that retrieves type strain sequences and metadata from LPSN, BacDive and NCBI, resolving synonym-based cross-database mismatches. QuickSearchProt automatically selects search parameter values for X!Tandem and Sage using a small spectral subset, targeting DDA data. GenomeDepot is an open-source web platform for annotating, managing and comparatively analyzing microbial genomes, with BLAST search and genome browsing. The distinctive feature across these tools is that automation targets reference and configuration inputs, namely taxonomic reference records, search parameters and genome annotation data, rather than downstream statistical modelling. The three tools span different domains, so the shared element is engineering for standardized, repeatable inputs rather than a single computational method.
